name: The Exiled Dead
inspire:
Friendly minions ({icon:minion}) begin the game Inspired.
After an enemy fighter is slain by a friendly minion ({icon:minion}), Inspire Deintalos and Marcov.

reactions.name: Dynamic Enhancer
reactions.rulesText: Friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighters have +X Move, where X is the number of slain friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighters.

reactions.name: Overload
reactions.rulesText: Friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighters cannot hold treasure tokens or Delve. Friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighters' melee weapons (excluding Upgrades) have Grievous ({icon:grievous}) if the target has any Stagger tokens.

reactions.name: Dynamic Surge
reactions.rulesText: You can re-roll 1 Attack dice in an Attack roll for a friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighter while any other friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighters are adjacent to the attacker.

abilities.name: Puppeteer
abilities.flavorText: Prentice Marcov is not yet the equal of his master's necromantic power, but he is certainly working to develop his dark skills.
abilities.rulesText:
Pick a friendly Marcov to use this ability if they have no Move or Charge tokens. Pick 1 of the following:

• That fighter and a friendly Regulus can each use a Core ability that they are eligible to use.

• If a friendly Regulus is slain, Raise them and place them in an empty hex adjacent to that fighter.

This ability can only be used once per battle round.

abilities.name: Danse Dynamic
abilities.flavorText: Deintalos is a master of the Force Dynamic, sending its crackling power through unliving limbs with ease.
abilities.rulesText:
Pick your leader ({icon:leader}) to use this ability if they have no Move or Charge tokens. Pick either the Move ability or the Attack ability. Each friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighter can use that ability.

Then, you can pick a slain friendly conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighter. Raise that conductive ({icon:conductive}) fighter, place them in an empty hex adjacent to your leader ({icon:leader}) and then inflict 1 damage on them.

playstyle: A seven-strong Death warband of fragile, two-wound zombie minions puppeteered by the necromancer Deintalos and his apprentice Marcov. The conductive minions start Inspired, re-roll attacks when packed together and gain Grievous against Staggered foes, while Deintalos moves or attacks with all of them at once and raises the fallen beside him. Slow at first, the horde grows faster as its bodies drop, winning by trading expendable minions for kills that Inspire its leaders and grinding opponents down.
